defaultDisabledPackagesEnabled.description: Opt in to the packages pir keeps disabled by default even when installed and listed in "packages" (currently @malinamnam/pi-phone: it starts a local web server and uses about 14 MB of QuickJS heap). Global settings scope only; an explicit -e/--extension path naming the package also enables it.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Default thinking level for new sessions.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Per-model default thinking level overrides keyed by "provider/modelId".

sessionShareDestination.description: Destination used by /share. "auto" uses Radius when authenticated and otherwise creates a GitHub gist.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model overrides keyed by exact "provider/modelId" strings.

enabled.description: Run the retention pass automatically at startup.

maxAgeDays.description: Delete sessions older than this many days.

maxSessions.description: Keep at most this many sessions per directory.

maxBytes.description: Keep newest sessions until this many bytes are retained.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the prompt and LLM response.

skipPrompt.description: When true, skips the "Summarize branch?" prompt and defaults to no summary.

baseDelayMs.description: Exponential backoff base delay in milliseconds: 2s, 4s, 8s.

timeoutMs.description: SDK or provider request timeout in milliseconds.

maxDelayMs.description: Legacy retry delay setting. Use provider.maxRetryDelayMs instead.

hideThinkingBlock.description: Hide collapsed thinking blocks in the transcript.

showCacheMissNotices.description: Show cache cost and provider recovery notices.

externalEditor.description: Command for Ctrl+G external editor; takes precedence over VISUAL and EDITOR.

shellPath.description: Custom shell path, for example for Cygwin on Windows, with support for leading ~ expansion.

quietStartup.description: When true, hide all startup output. When "header", keep only the startup header.

shellCommandPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every bash command, for example to enable shell aliases.

shellPool.description: Run bash and powershell commands through a persistent pooled shell process (one long-lived shell reused across calls, commands isolated in subshells). Disable to spawn a fresh shell process per command.

tools.description: Per-tool execution settings (pir extension; upstream ignores this object).

commandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for a bash/powershell command that does not pass its own timeout. Unset applies 120000 (120 seconds), a deliberate deviation from upstream's no-default-timeout so one hung command cannot consume an entire run; set 0 to restore upstream semantics. An explicit per-call timeout always wins. When exceeded, the command's process tree is killed and the tool returns an error naming this setting.

broadSearchGuard.description: Reject obvious whole-filesystem searches (`find /`, recursive grep/rg over /tmp or the home directory) before spawning a shell. Default true; set false to disable the guard.

npmCommand.description: Command used for npm package lookup and installation, in argv form such as ["mise", "exec", "node@20", "--", "npm"].

collapseChangelog.description: Show the condensed changelog after update; use /changelog for the full changelog.

enableInstallTelemetry.description: Send an anonymous version and update ping after changelog-detected updates.

enableAnalytics.description: Opt in to analytics data sharing.

trackingId.description: Analytics tracking identifier, generated when analytics is enabled.

anyOf.description: Load all resources from the package.

autoload.description: When false, start empty and only apply explicit resource patterns.

prompts.description: Prompt template paths or package globs.

items.description: Package source for npm or git packages. Use the string form to load all resources or the object form to filter resources.

packages.description: npm or git package sources, as strings or objects with resource filtering.

extensions.description: Local extension file paths or directories.

disabledBuiltinExtensions.description: Built-in extensions not to load, by name (such as "mcp"), even when settings or -e enable them; the settings spelling of --no-mcp. Names from the global and project scopes are unioned: a project can add a restriction but never re-enable a builtin disabled globally.

deviceId.description: Stable installation UUID, generated when authentication first needs it. Global only.

anyOf.description: Local skill file paths or directories.

skills.description: Local skill file paths or directories.

prompts.description: Local prompt template file paths or directories.

themes.description: Local theme file paths or directories.

showImages.description: Show images when the terminal supports them.

imageWidthCells.description: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear empty rows when content shrinks.

autoResize.description: Resize images to 2000x2000 maximum for better model compatibility.

blockImages.description: When true, prevents all images from being sent to LLM providers.

enabledModels.description: Model patterns for cycling, in the same format as the --models CLI flag.

defaultTools.description: Initial tool selection. Plain names replace the inherited selection; +name and -name entries add or remove tools.

performance.description: Opt-in performance controls. Absent or profile=balanced preserves the default behavior.

doubleEscapeAction.description: Action for double-escape with an empty editor.

thinkingBudgets.description: Custom token budgets for thinking levels.

editorPaddingX.description: Horizontal padding for the input editor.

autocompleteMaxVisible.description: Maximum visible items in the autocomplete dropdown.

showHardwareCursor.description: Show the terminal cursor while still positioning it for IME.

mode.description: How codemode presents tools. "on" keeps direct tools declared and annotates tools callable from scripts; codemode lists only tools without direct exposure. "only" lists every script-callable tool in codemode and does not declare active direct tools.

inlineBudget.description: Estimated tokens available for inline codemode tool declarations.

sandboxMemoryMb.description: QuickJS heap cap for one codemode script execution, in MiB (0 = no cap). Applied to both the in-process and worker-process sandboxes.

memoryMb.description: QuickJS heap cap for the shared extension runtime, in MiB (0 = no cap). An over-limit allocation fails that dispatch/tool call with a clear error; the host survives.

stackMb.description: JS stack size in MiB. 0 keeps the 16 MiB default; values above 16 are clamped to 16 (a larger value would disable QuickJS's stack check).

gcThresholdMb.description: QuickJS GC threshold in MiB (0 = QuickJS default pacing).

callTimeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds for extension dispatch and tool execution (default 30000; 0 keeps the default).

hookTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for reserved-prefix hook calls (__pir_stream: / __pir_route:; default 1800000; 0 keeps the default).

beforeAgentStartTimeoutMs.description: Budget for the before_agent_start lifecycle dispatch in milliseconds; 0 keeps the default (10 s). When it elapses the host stops waiting, the run proceeds, and the late handler's completion is discarded.

extensionLimits.description: QuickJS resource limits of the extension runtime. Global settings scope only: project .pi/settings.json cannot loosen these. PI_EXT_* environment variables override them.

pythonTool.description: Register the embedded RustPython 3 `python` tool (pir-only). Set false to skip it — for example when a custom `python` extension or the native-python path is preferred. `disabledBuiltinExtensions: ["python"]` removes the builtin at the loader layer regardless.

memory.description: Settings for the embedded `memory` builtin (cm-memory engine).

store.description: Where the cm file lives. `session` (default) puts it next to the session transcript; `workspace` uses <project-root>/cm; `agentDir` uses <agent-dir>/memory/<project-hash>/cm; `path` uses the explicit path setting.

path.description: Explicit cm file path used when store = "path" (relative paths resolve against the session cwd).

autoRecall.description: Append a budgeted <memory-context> block to each user prompt. Default true.

autoRecallPolicy.description: Auto-recall selection policy. `auto` (default) gives questions/long prompts the full brief; plain short edit prompts get no injection and continuation short edits get only the active task frame (no memory records); `always` keeps the full budget on every prompt; `off` disables injection.

autoRecallMinScore.description: Minimum top BM25 score for automatic recall when no frame exists. Default 1.0.

autoRecallMinPromptChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters skip auto mode. Default 40.

autoBrief.description: Inject a stable frame brief into the system prompt once per session. Default false.

recallBudgetTokens.description: Token budget for automatic recall. Default 600.

recallMaxItems.description: Maximum memories in automatic recall. Default 3.

write.description: Write policy. `readOnly` opens the store read-only and rejects every write action.

checkpointOnSettle.description: Checkpoint the store after a turn that wrote memory. Default true.

strictSources.description: Reject source anchors outside the project root. Default true.

maxStoreBytes.description: Maximum cm file size before writes are rejected. Default 256 MiB.

diskCache.description: Keep the disposable cm.cache next to the store. Default true.

allowExternalCommands.description: Allow `wiki generate` / `wiki review` to spawn external agent commands. Default false.

sessionDir.description: Custom session storage directory, in the same format as the --session-dir CLI flag.

httpProxy.description: Proxy URL applied as HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY for Pi-managed HTTP clients.

httpIdleTimeoutMs.description: HTTP header or body idle timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

cacheWarming.description: Cache-warming profile. "idle" also warms between agent runs. Global only because each refresh costs money.

websocketConnectTimeoutMs.description: WebSocket connect or open handshake timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

fullscreenExitOutput.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenScrollbar.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenCopyOnSelect.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenWheelScrollLines.description: Lines scrolled per wheel event in fullscreen mode; numeric values are clamped from 1 to 100.

keybindings.description: TUI keybinding overrides; pir also reads keybindings.json.
